injuries.summary:
## Injury briefing

### Biggest status changes
- **Saints WR Jordyn Tyson**: expected to miss **about two months** with a **hamstring injury**. The team says it’s separate from the spring issue.
  - **Why it matters:** New Orleans loses a top-end weapon early, and the offense has to adjust without its eighth overall pick.
  - **Watch next:** Whether the Saints place him on IR and who absorbs his targets.

- **Jaguars G Patrick Mekari**: underwent a **procedure on his back** and will miss **some time**. He’s expected to play this season, but IR to start the year is still being considered.
  - **Why it matters:** Jacksonville’s offensive line depth is already being tested.
  - **Watch next:** Whether he lands on IR before roster cutdown decisions.

- **Jaguars LB Parker Hughes**: placed on **injured reserve**; his rookie season is over.
  - **Why it matters:** Ends his year before it gets going and thins Jacksonville’s linebacker depth.

- **Vikings S/LB Jamal Adams**: confirmed to have **torn his quad tendon**.
  - **Why it matters:** This is a major injury and could wipe out a key defensive piece for Minnesota.

- **Buccaneers WR Emeka Egbuka**: dealing with a **toe sprain**, listed as **day-to-day / week-to-week**, and Week 1 availability is uncertain.
  - **Why it matters:** Tampa Bay’s rookie WR plans may need to be adjusted right before the season.
  - **Watch next:** Whether his status improves in the next couple of weeks.

- **Rams rookie Keagen Trost**: expected to miss **a few weeks** with a **hamstring injury**.
  - **Why it matters:** Los Angeles loses a rookie depth option early.

### Other notable injury notes
- **Kyle Monangai**: knee injury, expected to miss **multiple weeks**. Team not specified.
- **Broncos LB Levelle Bailey**: has a **broken leg**, but Sean Payton said it’s unclear whether he’s out for the season; Denver has **not** put him on IR yet.
- **Panthers updates**:
  - **Ja’seem Reed**: calf injury, getting imaging today.
  - **Cam Gill**: shoulder soreness after finishing Saturday’s game.
  - **Will Lee**: groin injury, described as **nothing serious**.
  - **Haynes King**: won’t return this week; still **week to week**.

### Returning from injury / progress
- **Giants WR Malik Nabers**: participated in **live 11-on-11 drills** for the first time this summer as he works back from a torn ACL.
  - **Why it matters:** This is a meaningful step forward in his recovery and a positive sign for New York’s offense.

### One more roster injury move
- **Seahawks CB Shemar Jean-Charles**: placed on **injured reserve**.

### What to watch next
- Whether **Tyson**, **Egbuka**, and **Mekari** end up on IR or return sooner than expected.
- Whether **Nabers** keeps ramping up without setback.
- Any update on **Jamal Adams** and the full extent of Minnesota’s defensive damage.
